name: Feed the Monster!
competency: Understanding one-to-one correspondence, counting object sets, comparing quantities, and balancing collection with hunger slots
overview: A funny cartoon monster has empty cake slots in its stomach. Children count the slots, visit the bakery to collect the exact number of cakes, and feed the monster.
learningOutcomes: Count visible empty slots with accurate 1-to-1 correspondence
Identify and select matching cardinal numbers
Collect and manage a target quantity in an interactive basket
Compare collections: understand too few, too many, and exact match
